case_title: THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA vs. FRONTIER PACIFIC INS. CO. et al

docket_entries.description: EX PARTE APPLICATION FOR ORDER TO SET ASIDE/VACATE JUDGMENT, DECLARATION, ORDER FILED BY PLAINTIFF THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA JUDGMENT OF DEC-28-1994 SET ASIDE
SUMMARY JUDGMENT FILED BY PLAINTIFF THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA AS TO DEFENDANT FRONTIER PACIFIC INS. CO. PENINSULA BAIL BONDS

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FRONTIER PACIFIC INS. CO. PENINSULA BAIL BONDS $7,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $80.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,580.00
